title: Eight Sleep marquee track
description: An endless, slow sideways track: its items run in a single row from right to left at a steady pace and loop without a seam; hovering pauses it. With reduced motion it becomes a plain row you can scroll sideways.
notes: the items are drawn twice (the copy is hidden from screen readers) so the loop has no gap
name: eightsleep-marquee

props.name: items
props.description: the items, in order; each is one slot of the row

props.name: gap
props.description: gap between items: the default is 15px, wide is 16px on phones and 24px up
